correctness.rationale: The critical incidence-cycle matching characterization is explicit and primary-source consistent; only two directed perfect gradients are forbidden. Fixed orbit vertices and simplices admit inverse affine barycentric maps, giving PL homeomorphism. Rotation and reflection quotient adjacency calculations and t=1,2 exceptional cases are exhaustive by subgroup structure. Published cycle/path homotopy results supply the final wedge dimensions. The standalone actual rooted-forest verifier tests 151 parameter cases, 184212 orbit subsets and 68 mod-two homology cases; finite checks are corroborative only.
